# Verification Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](gmeow-VerificationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VerificationStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The outcome status of a verification result — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](gmeow-VerificationStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](../properties/gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) — the open set of individuals naming a verification verdict (verified, failed, unverified, expired, revoked, policy-failed, finality-pending).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-status subclasses (statuses are individuals) and avoid using it for ledger settlement (that is [`gmeow:LedgerFinalityStatus`](gmeow-LedgerFinalityStatus.md)); the verification status is a check verdict, not a chain state, and a 'verified' status is one verifier's observation, never global truth ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Reference one or more seeded [`gmeow:VerificationStatus`](gmeow-VerificationStatus.md) individuals on a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](gmeow-VerificationResult.md); combine compatible statuses (verified + expired) rather than picking one, and mint new individuals as new outcomes arise.

### Examples

- ex:verifyOutcome [`gmeow:hasVerificationStatus`](../properties/gmeow-hasVerificationStatus.md) [`gmeow:verificationStatusVerified`](../individuals/gmeow-verificationStatusVerified.md).
